name: Armada Cannabis Co. | 20mg Cider | Apple Cider
description:
A Match Made On The Farm.

Armada Cannabis Co. is Michigan to the core. When we decided to craft our infused Sparkling Apple, we knew it had to be made with real fruit. With 20mg of nano-emulsified cannabis in every can, our Infused Cider Mill Style is as smooth as your favorite fall flannel.

Whether you are on the farm or home by the bonfire, we invite you to sit back, and crack open a crisp Sweet Apple.

Notes: Made with real fruit, not too sweet or too dry. Best enjoyed cold with your favorite Cider Mill Donuts.
